note: Lowercase lexicon used by lsne.lang_id: 'D' German, 'E' English (function words, auxiliaries, common verbs/nouns/adjectives of everyday narratives with their inflected forms), 'N' proper names of the stimulus schema (always labelled 'N'). Words present in both D and E (listed under 'ambiguous', e.g. 'in', 'an', 'am', 'so', 'man', 'was', 'will', 'hat', 'stand') are resolved by the context majority of the neighbouring words within the same sentence.
